description: Simplifies recently changed or explicitly scoped code while preserving observable behavior, error semantics, side effects, ordering, and public contracts. Use for readability cleanup, dead-code removal, reducing nesting, eliminating redundant wrappers, or making an implementation easier to maintain. Not for architecture redesign, new behavior, speculative cleanup, or a refactor without an adequate safety net.
